Tidy Tuesday 2026, Week 2: The languages of Africa.

```{r}
#libraries
if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
library(pacman)
pacman::p_load(ggplot2, dplyr, tidyr, readr, plotly, starburstR,tibble,dplyr)
```

```{r}
africa <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-01-13/africa.csv')

```

```{r}
names(africa) #language, family, native_speakers (number), country
length(unique(africa$language)) #502 languages
length(unique(africa$family)) #17 language families
length(unique(africa$country)) #51 countries
range(africa$native_speakers) #12 to 150,000,000
#the number of native speakers by language appears to be correct for the entire continent but not by each country. For example, there are 150 million Arabic speakers on the continent, but couldn't be in Algeria (the population isn't that big).
africa %>% group_by(family,language) %>% summarize(N = n()) %>% arrange(desc(N))
```

```{r}
df <- africa %>%
  distinct(language, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% select(-c(country))
df_small <- df %>% filter(native_speakers <11250)
df_large <- df %>% filter(native_speakers >11249)
```

```{r}
# Root node
root <- tibble(
  id     = "African Languages",
  label  = "African Languages",
  parent = "",
  value  = sum(df$native_speakers, na.rm = TRUE)
)

# Families (aggregate native_speakers)
families <- df %>%
  group_by(family) %>%
  summarise(value = sum(native_speakers, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    id     = family,
    label  = family,
    parent = "African Languages"
  )

# Languages (leaf nodes)
languages <- df %>%
  transmute(
    id     = paste(family, language, sep = "::"),  # unique ID
    label  = language,
    parent = family,
    value  = native_speakers
  )

# Combine everything
sunburst_data <- bind_rows(root, families, languages)
```

```{r}
library(viridis)
family_colors <- sunburst_data %>%
  filter(parent == "African Languages") %>%
  mutate(color = viridis(n(), option = "D")) %>%
  select(id, color)

family_colors <- sunburst_data %>%
  filter(parent == "African Languages") %>%
  mutate(color = viridis(n(), option = "D")) %>%
  select(id, color)

# Join colors back to sunburst_data
sunburst_data <- sunburst_data %>%
  left_join(family_colors, by = c("parent" = "id")) %>%
  mutate(color = ifelse(is.na(color), "#dddddd", color))

fig <- plot_ly(
  data = sunburst_data,
  ids = ~id,
  labels = ~label,
  parents = ~parent,
  values = ~value,
  type = "sunburst",
  branchvalues = "total",
  marker = list(colors = ~color)
)
fig

```

Linguistic diversity by country (bigger bubbles, more languages per country)
```{r}
df_divers <- africa %>% 
  group_by(country) %>% summarize(tot_lang = length(unique(language)))

ggplot(df_divers, aes(x = reorder(country, tot_lang), y = tot_lang, size = tot_lang)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, color = "steelblue") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 15)) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "Country",
    y = "Number of Languages Spoken",
    size = "Languages"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(packcircles)
library(ggplot2)

# Generate circle packing layout
packing <- circleProgressiveLayout(df_divers$tot_lang, sizetype = "area")
df_bubbles <- cbind(df_divers, packing)

# Generate circle vertices for plotting
circle_data <- circleLayoutVertices(packing, npoints = 50)

# Plot
ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = circle_data, aes(x, y, group = id, fill = df_bubbles$country[id]), color = "black", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_text(data = df_bubbles, aes(x, y, label = country, size = tot_lang), vjust = -0.5) +
  geom_text(data = df_bubbles, aes(x, y, label = tot_lang, size = tot_lang), vjust = 1.5)+
  coord_equal() +
  scale_fill_viridis_d() +
  theme_void() +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 4)) +  # adjust min/max font size
  labs(title = "The linguistic diversity of African countries",
       subtitle = "Number of languages spoken by country",
       fill = "country",
       caption = "Lyndsay Miles | #TidyTuesday\nSource:Wikipedia")+
  theme(legend.position = "none")


```
